source_grounding.call_chain_traced: handler_v2.insert() → checkAndSetData() → json.Unmarshal([]byte(dataString), &vectorArray). Line 548 converts string to array without validating original JSON type.
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:REST v2 insert处理在checkAndSetData()函数中对FloatVector字段做json.Unmarshal(dataString, &vectorArray)。该实现先把字段值转为字符串(fieldValue.String())，再JSON解析该字符串，导致接受"[0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4]"这种合法JSON字符串的非法输入。正确做法应直接使用fieldValue.Raw并验证其为JSON array类型。

verdicts.rationale: REST v2 /entities/insert accepts vector field as JSON string "[0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4]" instead of requiring native JSON array format [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]. Source code at utils.go:548 performs json.Unmarshal(dataString, &vectorArray) which coerces string representations to arrays without type validation. This violates proper type checking and matches known REST v2 data type handling blindspot (8 historical issues). The API returns HTTP 200 success for malformed input, constituting Type1_IllegalSuccess defect.
